videos.title: Codex is buying Pokémon cards now
videos.description: Finding underpriced PSA-graded cards at $10,000-plus price points was previously a function of having more time, more people, and more domain expertise than competitors. Codex with browser access and a custom pricing skill collapses that advantage to a single well-written prompt.
